name: documentation
description: Fetches and manages technical documentation for 121+ technologies with version support and caching

envVars.name: KB_REPO_URL
envVars.description: URL of the knowledge base git repository

envVars.name: KB_REPO_BRANCH
envVars.description: Branch of the knowledge-base repository to read. Defaults to the repo default branch.

envVars.name: KB_CACHE_PATH
envVars.description: Directory for the on-disk knowledge-base cache. Defaults to a per-user cache directory.

envVars.name: KB_CACHE_TTL
envVars.description: Cache lifetime in seconds before the knowledge base is re-fetched. Defaults to 7200 (2 hours).

envVars.name: KB_ANALYTICS_PATH
envVars.description: File that records which docs were fetched, for the Analytics panel. Unset disables recording.
